Manaus: the Amazonas Theatre and city neighbourhoods beside a broad river

Transfer to the airport and fly to São Luís. On arrival, transfer to your hotel, check in and enjoy some free time.

São Luís is a historic city on the Atlantic coast. The nearby Lençóis Maranhenses region is said to have some of the cleanest air on the planet. The city is surrounded by mountains, and its climate is described as mild and pleasant.

The historic centre feels like an open-air museum. Stone-paved streets give way to narrow lanes, and the buildings retain many architectural details from the colonial period.

One of the most prominent landmarks is the Palace of the Lions, an example of 17th-century French architecture decorated with columns, porticoes and stucco. Sculpted lions guard the staircase leading to the palace.

São Luís is also known as Brazil’s reggae capital, and the Jamaican music style is especially popular here. The city has museums, markets and surviving 17th-century churches. Rice is a staple of the local cuisine. Along the coast you can go windsurfing, diving or fishing, or simply relax on the beach.

Overnight in São Luís.
